section_summary.extract_value: This section details Confirmatory Factor Analyses (CFAs) conducted on two separate samples to examine the K-DOCS' factor structure. The analyses involved two methods (all items as indicators vs. parceled items) and three models (single-factor, five-factor, and five-factor with a second-order creativity factor). The results indicated that the five-factor model without a second-order creativity factor provided the best fit for the data across both samples.
